mods.description: Axiom addon: Floating Rock and Twist Spline tools.

releases.notes:
New tool Sky Spike: simple settings modelled on the reference tool

Same slider set as the reference: Radius, Height, Separate Width X/Z, Width,
Upside Down, Noise (Detail, Frequency, Sharpness, Warp), Twist (X, Z, Center,
Radius); extras folded away (Noise Advanced, Falloff, Terrain).
Defaults are the reference values (R 18, Height 4.702, Detail 2, Frequency 0.05,
Sharpness 1.298, Warp 0.25, Twist X 64.858).

Every top column hangs to its own depth = falloff x 2D noise, so walls are vertical
strips with stepped ends; Twist X spirals the spike toward the tip, Twist Z bends it;
stepped mound on top. Presets and Rotate sections are now collapsed by default.

mods.description: Axiom addon: Floating Rock and Twist Spline tools.

releases.notes:
Floating Rock rebuilt from hanging columns; new Fluted Rock tool

Floating Rock:
- Top outline is a polygon: every rim column is one flat face, some stick out
- Rock = concentric rings of flat-faced columns hanging from the top; outer columns
  short, inner long -> stepped taper like hand-built rock assets
- Silhouette: Taper, Straight Wall Height, Tip Thickness, Lobes
- Columns: width/variation, depth step, wobble, offset, length variation,
  long drip columns, cleanup (no 1-wide strips); scale with radius
- Twist rotates layers, Lean shifts them

Fluted Rock (new): radius profile (top width, bulge, rounded top/base, sink) with
billow flutes stretched along Y (rounded ribs, sharp grooves) + fine flutes, twist,
lumps; ribs fade on the rounded top, floating bits removed.

releases.notes:
Floating Rock: per-side stretch, tip thickness, voxel cleanup, mound follows the top outline

- Replace Width X/Z Ratio with Stretch East/West/South/North (+X/-X/+Z/-Z) on top of Radius/Height
- Tip Thickness + Tip Rounding: the spike can end in a thick rounded cap instead of a point
- Plate offsets are capped by the local radius, so the thin tip no longer breaks into loose blocks
- Smoothing pass: 3x3 majority per layer, Min Step Height per column, despeckle of lone blocks
- Top Mound is a smooth height field from the real top outline (distance to edge + low noise),
  never placed over air; new Mound Spread / Mound Bumps / Bump Size
